title: Audience Overlap Network
description: Selected-channel audience links sized by shared-chatter overlap. Edge labels show shared chatters and Jaccard similarity.

targets.rawSql:
WITH audience_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    channel_name,
    COALESCE(user_id, 'name:' || LOWER(user_name)) AS chatter_key
  FROM twitch_event_chat
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
    AND channel_name IN (${channel:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(user_id, user_name) IS NOT NULL
), audience_sizes AS (
  SELECT channel_name, COUNT(*) AS audience_size
  FROM audience_members
  GROUP BY channel_name
), overlaps AS (
  SELECT
    left_members.channel_name AS source,
    right_members.channel_name AS target,
    COUNT(*) AS shared_chatters
  FROM audience_members left_members
  JOIN audience_members right_members
    ON right_members.chatter_key = left_members.chatter_key
   AND right_members.channel_name > left_members.channel_name
  GROUP BY left_members.channel_name, right_members.channel_name
)
SELECT
  source || ' -> ' || target AS id,
  source,
  target,
  shared_chatters::text || ' shared' AS "mainStat",
  ROUND((100.0 * shared_chatters / NULLIF(source_size.audience_size + target_size.audience_size - shared_chatters, 0))::numeric, 1)::text || '%' AS "secondaryStat",
  ROUND((1.0 + 9.0 * shared_chatters / NULLIF(LEAST(source_size.audience_size, target_size.audience_size), 0))::numeric, 2) AS thickness
FROM overlaps
JOIN audience_sizes source_size ON source_size.channel_name = source
JOIN audience_sizes target_size ON target_size.channel_name = target
ORDER BY shared_chatters DESC, source, target
LIMIT 100

title: Bridge Chatters
description: Chatters active in multiple selected channels, ranked by the number of channel pairs their activity connects.

targets.rawSql:
WITH scoped_events AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(user_id, 'name:' || LOWER(user_name)) AS chatter_key,
    COALESCE(MAX(display_name) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(user_id, 'name:' || LOWER(user_name))), MAX(user_name) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(user_id, 'name:' || LOWER(user_name))), COALESCE(user_id, 'name:' || LOWER(user_name))) AS chatter,
    channel_name
  FROM twitch_event_chat
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
    AND channel_name IN (${channel:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(user_id, user_name) IS NOT NULL
), chatter_activity AS (
  SELECT
    chatter_key,
    MAX(chatter) AS chatter,
    COUNT(*) AS messages,
    COUNT(DISTINCT channel_name) AS channels
  FROM scoped_events
  GROUP BY chatter_key
)
SELECT
  chatter AS "Chatter",
  channels AS "Channels",
  (channels * (channels - 1) / 2) AS "Connected pairs",
  messages AS "Messages"
FROM chatter_activity
WHERE channels > 1
ORDER BY "Connected pairs" DESC, "Messages" DESC, "Chatter"
LIMIT 25

title: Home-Channel Loyalty
description: Average and median share of each chatter's selected-channel messages sent to their most-active channel. Chatters need at least two messages.

targets.rawSql:
WITH scoped_events AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(user_id, 'name:' || LOWER(user_name)) AS chatter_key,
    channel_name
  FROM twitch_event_chat
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
    AND channel_name IN (${channel:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(user_id, user_name) IS NOT NULL
), chatter_channels AS (
  SELECT chatter_key, channel_name, COUNT(*) AS channel_messages
  FROM scoped_events
  GROUP BY chatter_key, channel_name
), ranked_channels AS (
  SELECT
    chatter_key,
    channel_name,
    channel_messages,
    SUM(channel_messages) OVER (PARTITION BY chatter_key) AS total_messages,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY chatter_key ORDER BY channel_messages DESC, channel_name) AS channel_rank
  FROM chatter_channels
), home_channels AS (
  SELECT
    channel_name AS home_channel,
    100.0 * channel_messages / NULLIF(total_messages, 0) AS loyalty
  FROM ranked_channels
  WHERE channel_rank = 1
    AND total_messages >= 2
)
SELECT
  home_channel AS "Home channel",
  ROUND(AVG(loyalty)::numeric, 1) AS "Average loyalty",
  ROUND((PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY loyalty))::numeric, 1) AS "Median loyalty"
FROM home_channels
GROUP BY home_channel
ORDER BY "Average loyalty" DESC, "Home channel"

title: Cross-Channel Migration Matrix
description: Transitions between consecutive channel runs when the next selected channel is reached within 60 minutes.

targets.rawSql:
WITH scoped_events AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    event_time,
    channel_name,
    COALESCE(user_id, 'name:' || LOWER(user_name)) AS chatter_key
  FROM twitch_event_chat
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
    AND channel_name IN (${channel:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(user_id, user_name) IS NOT NULL
), run_boundaries AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN LAG(channel_name) OVER (PARTITION BY chatter_key ORDER BY event_time, id) IS DISTINCT FROM channel_name THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS starts_new_run
  FROM scoped_events
), numbered_events AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(starts_new_run) OVER (PARTITION BY chatter_key ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS run_number
  FROM run_boundaries
), channel_runs AS (
  SELECT
    chatter_key,
    run_number,
    channel_name,
    MIN(event_time) AS run_start,
    MAX(event_time) AS run_end
  FROM numbered_events
  GROUP BY chatter_key, run_number, channel_name
), transitions AS (
  SELECT
    chatter_key,
    channel_name AS origin_channel,
    run_end,
    LEAD(channel_name) OVER (PARTITION BY chatter_key ORDER BY run_number) AS destination_channel,
    LEAD(run_start) OVER (PARTITION BY chatter_key ORDER BY run_number) AS destination_time
  FROM channel_runs
)
SELECT
  origin_channel AS "From",
  destination_channel AS "To",
  COUNT(*) AS "Transitions",
  COUNT(DISTINCT chatter_key) AS "Chatters",
  ROUND((100.0 * COUNT(*) / NULLIF(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY origin_channel), 0))::numeric, 1) AS "Origin share"
FROM transitions
WHERE destination_channel IS NOT NULL
  AND destination_time <= run_end + INTERVAL '60 minutes'
GROUP BY origin_channel, destination_channel
ORDER BY "Transitions" DESC, "From", "To"
LIMIT 100

title: Strongest Community Edges
description: Channel pairs ranked by cosine similarity of their selected-range chatter audiences.

targets.rawSql:
WITH audience_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    channel_name,
    COALESCE(user_id, 'name:' || LOWER(user_name)) AS chatter_key
  FROM twitch_event_chat
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
    AND channel_name IN (${channel:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(user_id, user_name) IS NOT NULL
), audience_sizes AS (
  SELECT channel_name, COUNT(*) AS audience_size
  FROM audience_members
  GROUP BY channel_name
), overlaps AS (
  SELECT
    left_members.channel_name AS channel_a,
    right_members.channel_name AS channel_b,
    COUNT(*) AS shared_chatters
  FROM audience_members left_members
  JOIN audience_members right_members
    ON right_members.chatter_key = left_members.chatter_key
   AND right_members.channel_name > left_members.channel_name
  GROUP BY left_members.channel_name, right_members.channel_name
)
SELECT
  channel_a || ' <-> ' || channel_b AS "Community edge",
  ROUND((100.0 * shared_chatters / NULLIF(SQRT(size_a.audience_size::numeric * size_b.audience_size::numeric), 0))::numeric, 1) AS "Cosine similarity"
FROM overlaps
JOIN audience_sizes size_a ON size_a.channel_name = channel_a
JOIN audience_sizes size_b ON size_b.channel_name = channel_b
ORDER BY "Cosine similarity" DESC, shared_chatters DESC, "Community edge"
LIMIT 20

title: Chatter Gravity & Channel Reach
description: Observed reach counts channels, effective reach discounts uneven activity concentration, and home gravity measures concentration in the most-used selected channel.

targets.rawSql:
WITH scoped_events AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(user_id, 'name:' || LOWER(user_name)) AS chatter_key,
    COALESCE(display_name, user_name, user_id) AS chatter,
    channel_name
  FROM twitch_event_chat
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
    AND channel_name IN (${channel:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(user_id, user_name) IS NOT NULL
), channel_activity AS (
  SELECT
    chatter_key,
    MAX(chatter) AS chatter,
    channel_name,
    COUNT(*) AS channel_messages
  FROM scoped_events
  GROUP BY chatter_key, channel_name
), reach_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    chatter_key,
    MAX(chatter) AS chatter,
    COUNT(*) AS observed_reach,
    SUM(channel_messages) AS messages,
    SUM(channel_messages)::numeric * SUM(channel_messages)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(channel_messages::numeric * channel_messages::numeric), 0) AS effective_reach,
    100.0 * MAX(channel_messages) / NULLIF(SUM(channel_messages), 0) AS home_gravity
  FROM channel_activity
  GROUP BY chatter_key
)
SELECT
  chatter AS "Chatter",
  messages AS "Messages",
  observed_reach AS "Observed reach",
  ROUND(effective_reach, 2) AS "Effective reach",
  ROUND((100.0 * effective_reach / NULLIF(observed_reach, 0))::numeric, 1) AS "Reach efficiency",
  ROUND(home_gravity::numeric, 1) AS "Home gravity"
FROM reach_metrics
WHERE observed_reach > 1
ORDER BY "Effective reach" DESC, "Messages" DESC, "Chatter"
LIMIT 25

title: Chatter Circadian Fingerprint
description: Local-hour shares of selected-channel messages and active chatter-hours in the dashboard timezone.

targets.rawSql:
WITH hours AS (
  SELECT GENERATE_SERIES(0, 23) AS local_hour
), hourly_activity AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM event_time AT TIME ZONE '${timezone}')::integer AS local_hour,
    COUNT(*) AS messages,
    COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(user_id, 'name:' || LOWER(user_name))) AS active_chatters
  FROM twitch_event_chat
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
    AND channel_name IN (${channel:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(user_id, user_name) IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1
), complete_hours AS (
  SELECT
    hours.local_hour,
    COALESCE(hourly_activity.messages, 0) AS messages,
    COALESCE(hourly_activity.active_chatters, 0) AS active_chatters
  FROM hours
  LEFT JOIN hourly_activity USING (local_hour)
)
SELECT
  LPAD(local_hour::text, 2, '0') || ':00' AS "Local hour",
  ROUND((100.0 * messages / NULLIF(SUM(messages) OVER (), 0))::numeric, 1) AS "Message share",
  ROUND((100.0 * active_chatters / NULLIF(SUM(active_chatters) OVER (), 0))::numeric, 1) AS "Active chatter-hour share"
FROM complete_hours
ORDER BY local_hour

title: Routine Regularity
description: Share of local calendar days on which a chatter was active between their first and last observed day. Requires at least three active days.

targets.rawSql:
WITH daily_activity AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(user_id, 'name:' || LOWER(user_name)) AS chatter_key,
    MAX(COALESCE(display_name, user_name, user_id)) AS chatter,
    (event_time AT TIME ZONE '${timezone}')::date AS local_date
  FROM twitch_event_chat
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
    AND channel_name IN (${channel:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(user_id, user_name) IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY COALESCE(user_id, 'name:' || LOWER(user_name)), (event_time AT TIME ZONE '${timezone}')::date
), regularity AS (
  SELECT
    chatter_key,
    MAX(chatter) AS chatter,
    COUNT(*) AS active_days,
    MAX(local_date) - MIN(local_date) + 1 AS observed_days
  FROM daily_activity
  GROUP BY chatter_key
)
SELECT
  chatter AS "Chatter",
  ROUND((100.0 * active_days / NULLIF(observed_days, 0))::numeric, 1) AS "Regularity"
FROM regularity
WHERE active_days >= 3
ORDER BY "Regularity" DESC, active_days DESC, "Chatter"
LIMIT 20

title: Night-Owl Score (00:00-05:59)
description: Share of each chatter's selected-range messages sent from midnight through 05:59 in the dashboard timezone. Requires at least five messages.

targets.rawSql:
WITH scoped_events AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(user_id, 'name:' || LOWER(user_name)) AS chatter_key,
    COALESCE(display_name, user_name, user_id) AS chatter,
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM event_time AT TIME ZONE '${timezone}')::integer AS local_hour
  FROM twitch_event_chat
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
    AND channel_name IN (${channel:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(user_id, user_name) IS NOT NULL
), night_scores AS (
  SELECT
    chatter_key,
    MAX(chatter) AS chatter,
    COUNT(*) AS messages,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE local_hour BETWEEN 0 AND 5) AS night_messages
  FROM scoped_events
  GROUP BY chatter_key
)
SELECT
  chatter AS "Chatter",
  ROUND((100.0 * night_messages / NULLIF(messages, 0))::numeric, 1) AS "Night-owl score"
FROM night_scores
WHERE messages >= 5
  AND night_messages > 0
ORDER BY "Night-owl score" DESC, messages DESC, "Chatter"
LIMIT 20

title: Chatter Archetypes: Burstiness & Dominance
description: Behavioral classification combining inter-message burstiness, cross-channel reach, activity volume, and peak share of a selected channel's conversation.

targets.rawSql:
WITH scoped_events AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    event_time,
    channel_name,
    COALESCE(user_id, 'name:' || LOWER(user_name)) AS chatter_key,
    COALESCE(display_name, user_name, user_id) AS chatter
  FROM twitch_event_chat
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
    AND channel_name IN (${channel:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(user_id, user_name) IS NOT NULL
), ordered_events AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM event_time - LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY chatter_key ORDER BY event_time, id)) AS gap_seconds
  FROM scoped_events
), chatter_stats AS (
  SELECT
    chatter_key,
    MAX(chatter) AS chatter,
    COUNT(*) AS messages,
    COUNT(DISTINCT channel_name) AS channel_reach,
    AVG(gap_seconds) FILTER (WHERE gap_seconds >= 0) AS mean_gap,
    STDDEV_SAMP(gap_seconds) FILTER (WHERE gap_seconds >= 0) AS gap_deviation
  FROM ordered_events
  GROUP BY chatter_key
), channel_totals AS (
  SELECT channel_name, COUNT(*) AS channel_messages
  FROM scoped_events
  GROUP BY channel_name
), chatter_channel_shares AS (
  SELECT
    scoped_events.chatter_key,
    scoped_events.channel_name,
    100.0 * COUNT(*) / NULLIF(channel_totals.channel_messages, 0) AS channel_share
  FROM scoped_events
  JOIN channel_totals USING (channel_name)
  GROUP BY scoped_events.chatter_key, scoped_events.channel_name, channel_totals.channel_messages
), combined_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    chatter_stats.*,
    COALESCE(MAX(chatter_channel_shares.channel_share), 0) AS peak_channel_dominance,
    COALESCE((gap_deviation - mean_gap) / NULLIF(gap_deviation + mean_gap, 0), 0) AS burstiness
  FROM chatter_stats
  LEFT JOIN chatter_channel_shares USING (chatter_key)
  GROUP BY chatter_stats.chatter_key, chatter_stats.chatter, chatter_stats.messages, chatter_stats.channel_reach, chatter_stats.mean_gap, chatter_stats.gap_deviation
)
SELECT
  chatter AS "Chatter",
  CASE
    WHEN peak_channel_dominance >= 20 AND messages >= 10 THEN 'Conversation anchor'
    WHEN burstiness >= 0.30 AND messages >= 10 THEN 'Burst participant'
    WHEN channel_reach >= 3 THEN 'Cross-channel explorer'
    WHEN messages >= 20 THEN 'Steady regular'
    ELSE 'Occasional chatter'
  END AS "Archetype",
  messages AS "Messages",
  channel_reach AS "Channel reach",
  ROUND(burstiness::numeric, 2) AS "Burstiness",
  ROUND(peak_channel_dominance::numeric, 1) AS "Peak channel dominance"
FROM combined_metrics
WHERE messages >= 5
ORDER BY "Messages" DESC, "Peak channel dominance" DESC, "Chatter"
LIMIT 50
